# dagsterplus_secret (Resource)

Manages a Dagster+ environment secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Secret available to all full deployments
resource "dagsterplus_secret" "api_key" {
  secret_name          = "MY_API_KEY"
  secret_value         = "super-secret-api-key-value"
  full_deployment_scope = true
}

# Secret scoped to specific code locations
resource "dagsterplus_secret" "db_password" {
  secret_name    = "DB_PASSWORD"
  secret_value   = "my-database-password"
  location_names = ["data-pipeline", "analytics"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_name` (String) The name of the secret (e.g. MY_API_KEY).
- `secret_value` (String, Sensitive) The value of the secret.

### Optional

- `all_branch_deployments_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to all branch deployments.
- `full_deployment_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to the full deployment.
- `local_deployment_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to local deployments.
- `location_names` (List of String) Code location names the secret is scoped to. Empty means all locations.
- `specific_branch_deployment_scope` (String) A specific branch deployment name to scope the secret to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The secret ID assigned by Dagster+.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a secret by its server-assigned ID
terraform import dagsterplus_secret.api_key <secret-id>
```
